name: aipcb
description: Design, simulate, review and fab-export PCBs on your Mac: Claude writes design.yaml, KiCad 10 does the rest — offline.
long_description:
aipcb turns Claude into a circuit designer and design reviewer. Describe a circuit in plain language; Claude picks KiCad parts, writes design.yaml and runs the local flow: schematic, ERC, physics-based placement, 2-layer autorouting with GND pour, DRC with pour repair, ngspice simulations, design checks and previews. An AI review (PASS / CONDITIONAL / FAIL) gates the Gerber / BOM / CPL export.

**Requires KiCad 10** installed at /Applications/KiCad (its kicad-cli, libraries, libngspice and Python are used). Everything runs locally; no network access is needed after the Python dependencies are installed.

projects_dir.title: Projects folder
projects_dir.description: Folder holding one sub-folder per board (each with design.yaml). Shared with the aipcb CLI / GUI when you point it at the repo's projects/ folder.

exports_dir.title: Exports folder
exports_dir.description: Where export_project writes archives and import_project keeps backups.
